name: mirage
text: SX Bet is not a matching problem. SX flags 12 games in play right now; 7 are in Vigilant's leagues and matched with their markets read (the other 5 are in leagues Vigilant doesn't price). Only 1 has a price it will trust, because by design a live exchange price counts only if SX pushed that book after the game's last score change, and SX's in-play books for the rest are thin or quiet. I'm leaving that safety as is. ParlayAPI: found a likely source of waste. Its live play-by-play stream bills 5 credits for every connection, and each of the 5 sports connected twice within minutes of the restart, so connections that end early were being re-opened every 20 s. They now back off (20 s, then doubling to 15 min) unless a connection lasts 5 minutes, and the engine log shows connections per sport; I'll check the credit rate again in a while.
